warnings: Second pile-cap enlargement sheet, same layout convention as S-07: section on top, plan below, with the section arrows numbered by the pile count (6-6 for F6, 8-8 for F8).
F8 IS THE FIRST CAP WITH UNEQUAL TOP AND BOTTOM STEEL: 14-Ø12 top against 12-Ø12 bottom. F1, F3 and F6 all use the same tag top and bottom. Recorded as printed, not averaged.
Cap thickness grows with pile count across the set so far: F3 0.20, F6 0.25, F8 0.30. F1 is the exception at 0.80 -- it is a deep block, not a mat (see S-07).

Both caps use the same 1.00 m from datum to cap top, the same 0.05 pile-head embedment, the same 0.30 pier width, the same 0.10 lean-concrete projection and the same 0.08 lean concrete over 0.08 compacted sand.
ระดับหัวเสาเข็ม is not printed as a figure; it is computed here from the printed chain (cap top at -1.00, plus the cap thickness, less the 0.05 embedment) giving -1.20 for F6 and -1.25 for F8.
Pile spacing is 0.70 m in the number direction on both caps (the 0.35 / 0.70 / 0.70 / 0.35 chain), and 0.70 m on F6 versus 0.60 m on F8 in the letter direction.
NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: a packed size string (e.g. "0.20x0.40") was replaced by numeric width_mm/height_mm per schema 0.5; the printed text is kept in the matching *_printed_as field.
